name: Kaimono
title: Dokkai Dojo
lead: JLPT reading drills N5-N1 set at a fictional shopping street: a sale-day change notice, a first solo errand, a renovation closure notice, a home-delivery plan comparison, a receipt that reveals a small discovery, teaching a new part-timer how to price produce, why the street introduced a shared point card, a stamp-rally application guide, how online orders reshaped a vegetable shop's work, new year-end preorder rules, a reflection on shopping and the human mind, and a year-end report on vacant-shop countermeasures. Original texts, answers with the reason for every choice.
